name: gpu-fleet-poc-video
description: 60 second video about the NVIDIA GPU Fleet PoC, rendered with Remotion

scripts.finalize: ffmpeg -y -i out/gpu-fleet-poc-60s.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -preset slow -movflags +faststart dist/gpu-fleet-poc-60s.mp4 && cp out/poster.png dist/
